statements.quote: On October 16th, TeraWulf priced a $3.2 billion offering of 7.750% senior secured notes due 2030 at par to finance the construction of 522.5 MW of AI / High Powered Compute Data Centers at our Flagship Lake Mariner Campus
statements.notes: The $3.2 billion is a debt financing amount, not a stated capital expenditure amount, so it is recorded as qualitative (rule 4). The sentence ties planned data-center construction spend to AI/HPC. The slide text has no terminal period; the quote ends where the sentence runs into slide labels. Separately, p05's 'CIP ($8-10M/MW)' is a per-MW unit cost, not a total, so it is not recorded.

none_found.reason: no sentence quantifies or attributes operating expenses to AI

no fiscal-year AI or data-center revenue figure is stated; '~$6.7B contracted revenue; extensions up to ~$15B' (p04) is multi-year lease backlog over 10-year terms and cannot be attributed to a fiscal year without inference
